name: Gridline ZipPanel Modular Vest
description: A lightweight puffer vest built from zip-off front panels — each quilted section detaches independently so you can shed bulk without removing the whole garment. Dusty olive shell with copper-tone zippers that run diagonally across the chest. Spinal-rig channel runs the full back seam with velcro-close covers.
functionality: Independent zip-off front panels; rear spinal-rig channel with velcro covers; packable into front pocket.
what_it_says: Practical, no-nonsense layering from someone who's been caught underdressed by a lake-effect front more than once.
story_hooks: The inner panel lining has a hidden pocket stitched shut — something was sewn inside and someone didn't want it found easily.
Gridline stopped making this colorway two seasons ago; the copper zippers are now a quiet identifier among a specific courier network.
